items.question: Money, personal-data/erasure and legal posture: what stance does this spec take?
options: No money/refunds/credits; data stays in the user's self-hosted DB; no MCP delete path, redrafts never destroy a letter, erasure stays the in-app delete; no compliance framing beyond self-hosting
Add an MCP delete path for cover letters
Overwrite a letter in place on redraft

items.question: How are cover-letter redraft versions stored?
options: New CoverLetter row per save, job repointed (matches in-app Regenerate, no migration)
Overwrite the current letter in place
New version table with a schema migration

items.question: Which token scope gates save_cover_letter?
options: New cover-letter write scope issued on new tokens, implied for old ones
No scope gate, like the resume-review tools

items.question: Does add_job's upsert path also lose the MCP-only (createdVia) restriction?
options: Yes, lift it with update_job (shared patch helper)
No, keep upsert limited to MCP-created duplicates

items.question: What does the 'date added' field on list/search rows mean?
options: Job createdAt (what get_job prints as Created)
